description: This PHP source file defines the ExecutableFinder class within the Drupal package_manager module. It provides functionality to locate executable paths such as 'composer' and 'rsync' based on configuration and project-specific logic.

classes.name: ExecutableFinder
classes.description: A class that finds executable paths based on configuration and project-specific logic, implementing ExecutableFinderInterface and LoggerAwareInterface.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds the path of a specified executable ('rsync' or 'composer'), using configuration, local project paths, or fallback methods.

methods.name: getLocalComposerPath
methods.description: Attempts to locate the Composer binary installed in the project's vendor directory, caching the result for efficiency.
